slack.page_description: Connect each Orvilo Agent to its own Slack bot. Members can DM the bot, @mention it in a channel, and type /issue to spin up a new Orvilo issue.
slack.setup_requirement: A Slack workspace where you can create and install apps, plus one xoxb- bot token and one xapp- app-level token.
slack.setup_step_1: Open the Slack app dashboard, create an app from the Orvilo manifest, and install it to your workspace.
slack.setup_step_2: Enable Socket Mode and generate an app-level token with connections:write; copy both xoxb- and xapp- tokens.
slack.setup_step_3: Click Connect Slack below, paste both tokens, and let Orvilo verify the app before saving them encrypted.
slack.managed_setup_requirement: A Slack workspace where you are allowed to install apps. Orvilo Cloud manages the Slack app and encrypted tokens.
slack.managed_setup_step_1: Click Connect Slack on this page. Orvilo opens Slack's official authorization page in your browser.
slack.managed_setup_step_2: Choose the Slack workspace, review the requested bot permissions, and approve the installation.
slack.managed_setup_step_3: Slack returns to this integrations page. Orvilo verifies the tenant, stores the installation, and starts receiving signed events automatically.

slack.not_enabled_self_host_hint: Self-hosters: see the project README for details.

wecom.page_description: Connect each Orvilo Agent to its own WeCom (企业微信) smart bot. Members can DM the bot, @ it in groups, and type /issue to spin up a new Orvilo issue. The Agent replies over a long WebSocket connection, so no public callback URL is required.

wecom.setup_step_2: Copy the Bot ID and the secret shown by WeCom. Keep the secret private because it may be displayed only once.
wecom.setup_step_3: Click Connect WeCom below, paste the credentials, and let Orvilo test the long connection before saving.

weixin.page_description: Connect each Orvilo Agent to its own Weixin account through the iLink QR flow. Members can message the account and the Agent replies through the configured Weixin channel.
weixin.setup_requirement: A personal WeChat account on your phone. No company, Official Account, WeCom organization, or developer AppID is required.
weixin.setup_step_1: Click Connect WeChat below; Tencent's official iLink authorization QR code appears on this page.
weixin.setup_step_2: Open WeChat → Scan, scan the QR code, and approve the authorization in WeChat. Enter a verification code here if requested.
weixin.setup_step_3: Keep this page open until authorization succeeds and the account is added; expired codes can be generated again without leaving the page.
weixin.not_enabled_description_suffix: on the server to enable Weixin installations.
weixin.not_enabled_self_host_hint: Self-hosters: see the project README for details.
weixin.preview_description: The at-rest key is set, but this deployment has not enabled the Weixin QR install flow yet.
weixin.empty_description: Choose an available Agent below to connect its Weixin account.
weixin.available_agents_description: Each Agent can have one Weixin account. The Agent owner or a workspace admin can start the QR flow.
weixin.no_available_agents: There are no Agents you can connect right now.
weixin.disconnect_confirm_description: The account will stop delivering Weixin messages to this workspace. The installation row is kept for audit; you can connect it again later.
weixin.connect_dialog_description: Scan this QR code in Weixin to connect {{agent}}. Keep this window open while authorization completes.
weixin.install_scan_hint: Scan the QR code in Weixin to continue.
weixin.install_scanned: QR code scanned. Waiting for Weixin to finish authorization…
weixin.verify_description: Weixin asked for an additional verification code. Enter the code shown in Weixin to continue.
weixin.install_error_verify_invalid: That verification code was not accepted. Check it in Weixin and try again.
weixin.install_error_expired: This authorization session expired. Start a new connection and scan the new QR code.
weixin.install_error_already_connected: This Weixin account is already installed for another Agent or workspace.
weixin.install_error_forbidden: You no longer have permission to manage this Agent. Ask a workspace admin to continue.
weixin.install_error_generic: Weixin authorization could not be completed. Start a new connection and try again.

telegram.page_description: Connect each Orvilo Agent to its own Telegram bot. Members can DM the bot, @mention it in a group, type /issue to spin up a new Orvilo issue, and watch the agent's reply stream live.
telegram.setup_requirement: A Telegram account and a bot token issued by the official @BotFather.
telegram.setup_step_1: Open @BotFather, send /newbot, and finish choosing the bot name and username.
telegram.setup_step_2: Copy the HTTP API token. Treat it like a password and do not paste it anywhere except the field below.
telegram.setup_step_3: Remove any existing webhook for this bot, then click Connect Telegram below; Orvilo verifies the token and stores it encrypted.
telegram.not_enabled_description_suffix: on the server to enable Telegram bot installations.
telegram.not_enabled_self_host_hint: Self-hosters: see the project README for details.
telegram.preview_description: The at-rest key is set, but installs are not available in this deployment yet. The Connect button will appear here once they are.
telegram.empty_description_prefix: Open an Agent in this workspace and click
telegram.empty_description_suffix: to install a bot for it.
telegram.disconnect_confirm_description: The bot will stop receiving Telegram messages for this workspace. Chat history in Orvilo is kept; you can re-connect later from the same Agent.
telegram.agent_bot_disconnect_tooltip: Unbind this Telegram bot from the Agent. The bot will stop receiving Telegram messages.
telegram.agent_bot_manage_tooltip: Open a chat with this bot in Telegram.
telegram.connect_dialog_description: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste its token below. The token is verified live and stored encrypted.
telegram.connect_docs_link: Step-by-step: connect your Orvilo agent to Telegram
telegram.connect_failed_toast: Could not connect the Telegram bot
